method: Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 surface reflectance (USGS, via Microsoft Planetary Computer), Landsat 5 TM / 8-9 OLI (Landsat 7 ETM+ after May 2003 only as a last resort), 30 m pixels resampled to a 15 m grid per site box. Per site and year: up to 4 October-November days (October ranked first; partly cloudy days >=30 % clear are added until every pixel has a clear observation, at least one day >=85 % clear) after the QA_PIXEL cloud / dilated-cloud / shadow mask; same-day scenes of one path joined; a day whose land share on its clear pixels differs from the composite by >0.2 is dropped (haze); if the box is not covered, the window widens to Oct-Nov of the neighbouring years, then Sep-Dec of the year. 1985 may use Oct-Nov 1984. Water = per-pixel median MNDWI (green - SWIR 1.6 um)/(green + SWIR) > 0 over the clear days; land = the rest (MNDWI <= 0 threshold, not tuned per site). permanent_land = land on every clear day. land_change = land in that year minus land in the base year inside the fixed box. CAVEATS: 'land' means land or vegetated marsh above water on those days: emergent and floating marsh (flotant) reads as land, so marsh that is still there but degraded or floating counts, and loss is the conversion of marsh to open water. Water level on each day (tide range ~0.3 m, but cold-front north winds in Nov push water out and expose mudflats, south winds and river stage push it in) moves the wet edge on the flat deltas and marsh fringes; bare wet mud can read either way, and on the Wax Lake / Atchafalaya deltas subaqueous bars and shallow mudflats are counted only when exposed. Sediment-laden water near the river outlets lowers MNDWI a little. Single years are noisy (see land_ha_that_day for the spread within a composite); read decades. Hectares are ground hectares (Mercator scale corrected).
